history.summary: A 2007 freehold 4BR in Balestier/Toa Payoh fringe (D12), a large 2,121 sqft at $2.8M / $1,320 psf. The low headline PSF is purely a function of the oversized unit — total quantum $2.8M is well above the deep-liquidity band, and weak 2.9%/yr appreciation on a thin 28-txn series makes this an illiquid, slow-growth hold.
history.rating_rationale: Headline $1,320 psf sits ~19% below the $1,624 district median, but that gap is driven by the 2,121 sqft size, not a bargain. $2.8M quantum thins the buyer pool sharply, appreciation is a soft 2.9%/yr (only 28 txn), and 1.43km/17-min to Toa Payoh MRT is a poor walk. Freehold tenure is the lone real positive; score_1000 485 is below market-typical.
red_flags: $2.8M quantum is well above the deep-liquidity band — narrow buyer pool
Low PSF is an oversized-unit artefact, not genuine value
Weak 2.9%/yr appreciation on a thin 28-txn series
2007 build — 19 years old, dated finishes likely
catalysts: Large 2,121 sqft layout suits multi-gen families seeking space
